gaps.name: crtBarrelDistortion
gaps.note: The CrtBarrelDistortionPort object lands at ME1 with glsl = null (effects plan 1.10); CRT keeps its input until the GLSL port.

gaps.name: dewarp360
gaps.note: The Dewarp360Port object lands at ME1 with glsl = null (effects plan 1.10); dewarp keeps its input until the GLSL port.

gaps.name: WK*
gaps.note: On-screen web views keep android.webkit.WebView; the WebKit shim is scoped to Moblin/VideoEffects/Browser/.

gaps.name: WKWebView*
gaps.note: Members of the in-app browser and login web views, which keep android.webkit.WebView.

gaps.name: MK*
gaps.note: Navigation and location views use MapKit search, directions and regions; the MapKit shim only covers the map widget's snapshotter.

gaps.name: CM*
gaps.note: Accelerometer and attitude users outside the effects keep their Android sensor code; the CoreMotion shim covers FixedHorizonEffect.

gaps.name: CMMotionManager.*
gaps.note: Accelerometer and attitude members used outside the effects.

gaps.name: AVSpeechSynthesizer.*
gaps.note: Chat text-to-speech keeps android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech; the speech shim is scoped to Moblin/VideoEffects/.

gaps.name: CIRadialGradient.composited
gaps.note: faceMask is rebound to a CIImage by guard let in createFacesMaskImage.

gaps.name: CIImage.offset
gaps.note: The name image is also a ReplayImage in that file; ReplayImage.offset is Moblin's own field.

gaps.name: TextEffect
gaps.note: Intended: timersEndTime becomes List<ContinuousClock.Instant>; R11.4 updates createTextEffect.

gaps.name: TextEffect.setEndTime
gaps.note: Intended: endTime becomes ContinuousClock.Instant; HE0.5 and HE0.6 update the callers.

gaps.name: TextEffect.setTimersEndTime
gaps.note: Intended: ContinuousClock.Instant end times; R11.5 updates updateTimers.

gaps.name: SnapshotEffect.appendSnapshot
gaps.note: Intended: takes the Core Image shim's CIImage; HE0.7 updates the caller.

gaps.name: ScoreboardEffect
gaps.note: Intended: canvasSize becomes a Compose Size; R11.3 updates the caller.

gaps.name: BrowserEffect
gaps.note: Intended: the context parameter goes away; R11.9 deletes the argument.

gaps.name: BrowserEffect.startLoadingTime
gaps.note: Intended: ContinuousClock.Instant; R11.10 updates updateBrowserWidgetStatus.

gaps.name: BrowserEffect.webView
gaps.note: Intended: a WKWebView; RU.1 borrows and returns the Android view.

gaps.name: FaceEffectPrivacyMode.*
gaps.note: Intended: BackgroundImage(CIImage?) and Icon(Bitmap?); HE9.1 updates toEffectSettings.

gaps.name: makeCatmullRomPath
gaps.note: Intended: List<CGPoint> and Double tension returning CGMutablePath; HE8.2 updates MaskEffectView.

gaps.name: VideoEffectsProcessor.canvasSize
gaps.note: Intended: a CGSize; R4.7 updates VideoUnit.

gaps.name: PngTuberEffect
gaps.note: Intended: the first parameter keeps the String type but may take Swift's name; R11.2 passes it positionally.

gaps.name: MapEffect.updateLocation
gaps.note: Intended: only updateLocation(location: android.location.Location) remains; the snapshot also holds today's MapLocation version beside the interim overload HE7.1, which R11.1's ME1 line calls.
